This registry already tracks Expedient as an existing operator record with facilities in Maryland and Pennsylvania, based on the companys own 2004 headquarters announcement and Data Center Dynamics coverage of the AMP Capital transaction.

Per the companys own site fetched this session, Expedients Milwaukee data center, designated MKE1, is located at 4777 W Ironwood in Franklin, Wisconsin, featuring 1.6 megawatts of critical IT load, a 2N UPS configuration, 3.0 megawatts of total generator capacity, 27,000 total square feet with 10,000 square feet of raised floor space, four on-net carriers, and SOC 1 and 2, HITRUST, CSF, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and CSA STAR certifications. This specific facility, recorded in this registry as Expedient Milwaukee in Franklin, Wisconsin, was not individually named in the operator-level research reused here; its operator field was blank in the source data and is set here to Expedient based on the facility own name and matching address, extending the existing Expedient operator record in this registry to a third state, Wisconsin.

reading:
Expedient traces to the October 2003 acquisition of Stargate Business, a Pittsburgh-based company, after which Expedient formally designated Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania as its headquarters in May 2004, citing Stargate's established infrastructure, management team, and the roughly 70 percent of Expedient's workforce already based there.

At the time of that 2004 announcement, Expedient was privately owned by chairman Steve Abbey and Steve Willens, operating as part of the Continental Broadband family, itself wholly owned by Landmark Communications, a private media and publishing conglomerate. Ownership has since changed: AMP Capital, an Australian investment firm, became Expedient's investment sponsor in a later transaction reported by Data Center Dynamics and PR Newswire, funding continued growth of its data center and enterprise cloud platforms.

The registry here tracks 3 Expedient facilities across two states, Maryland and Pennsylvania. The operator's current locations page could not be retrieved this session, so no up-to-date total facility count or full market list is recorded here, and this entry relies on historical founding and ownership-transaction sources rather than the operator's own current portfolio statistics.
